# MiniLibX 2.2

These are the unmodified x86-64 Linux wheels from the A-Maze-ing
`mlx-2.2.tgz` supplied by 42. The Ubuntu and Fedora variants contain
their respective builds of `libmlx.so`. The adjacent `LICENSE` is the
MIT copyright and permission notice from the upstream source archive.
